warnings: Vertical riser schematic -- the one sheet that shows the whole water and drainage system as a single system rather than floor by floor. Drawn against the three architectural levels (+0.00 / +0.40 / +3.40).

*** IT RESOLVES THE AVC AMBIGUITY LEFT BY SN-01 AND SN-05: the vent terminal is the SIDE-WALL type ('ชนิดต่อออกด้านข้างผนัง'). *** SN-01 lists two AVC variants distinguishable only by drawn symbol and SN-05 tags the size without the type.

*** BUT IT INTRODUCES A NEW CONFLICT: the water tank's standard is printed 'มอก.989' here and 'มอก.1989' on SN-04. *** Everything else about the tank matches exactly -- stainless, 1 m³, complete stand, 0.10 m base slab with ø9@0.20 mesh. One of the two is a typo. Neither sheet is overridden; both are recorded as printed and flagged.

THE WATER SIZING LOGIC IS ONLY LEGIBLE HERE: the incoming main, the meter, the tank feed, the pump and the distribution are all ø3/4", and only the riser to the second floor steps up to ø1". A floor-by-floor plan cannot show that.
The bypass round the booster pump is drawn with a valve each side, which the SN-04 plan does not make clear.
Two cleanouts sit at the foot of the stacks below the ground slab -- the only place in the set they are located vertically.
